items.headline: Northwestern safety Jon Jon Stevens exits in second half with upper-body injury
items.description: Northwestern starting safety Jon Jon Stevens was carted off the field in the third quarter at Oregon on Saturday after delivering a hard blow on a tackle, and the team later announced he was being evaluated in the locker room for an upper-body injury.

items.headline: NFL scouts favor Drew Mestemaker as first QB taken in draft
items.description: In a midseason poll of 25 NFL scouts, Oklahoma State's Drew Mestemaker was the overwhelming choice to be the first quarterback selected in the 2027 NFL draft.

items.headline: Oregon freshman WR Messiah Hampton arrested in connection with high-speed chase
items.description: Oregon freshman WR Messiah Hampton is facing charges of attempting to elude police and reckless driving in connection with an Oct. 18 high-speed chase.
